summary: The purpose of this report is to provide City Council with the results of the collective bargaining negotiations between the City of Toronto and the Toronto Civic Employees Union Local 416, and to seek ratification by Council of the negotiated agreements.
decided: City Council on December 20, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council ratify and approve the Memorandum of Settlement between the City of Toronto and the Toronto and Toronto Civic Employees Union Local 416 - Main Unit, in Confidential Attachment 3 to the report (December 19, 2024) from the City Manager and the Chief People Officer. 2. City Council request the Mayor to include the necessary adjustments to the 2025 Non-Program Expenditure Budget and Operating Budgets of the Divisions to reflect provisions of the Memorandum of Settlement - Main Unit. 3. City Council authorize staff to make the necessary amendments to rates of pay, benefits and other issues identified as agreed changes in the new Memorandum of Settlement - Main Unit. 4. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (December 19, 2024) from the City Manager and the Chief People Officer remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to labour relations or employee negotiations. 5. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 3 and 4 to the report (December 19, 2024) from the City Manager and the Chief People Officer remain confidential at this time, as they relate to labour relations or employee negotiations. 6.
